headline: This joint resolution would have ended the national emergency the President declared on February 15, 2019, related to the U.S.-Mexico border.
what_it_does: If adopted, this resolution would have terminated the national emergency the President declared on February 15, 2019, concerning the U.S.-Mexico border. The official summary does not list specific programs, funds, or rules that would have changed. Those details would depend on the full text and on which emergency powers were tied to the declaration.

who_it_affects.group: The President and federal agencies using emergency powers tied to the border declaration
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the authority that comes from the February 15, 2019 national emergency declaration once it was terminated.
